{'text': 'iOS 27 is a major update to Apple\'s "Photos" app, with improvements to slideshows and shared albums, as well as the addition of a camera roll type feature that many users have been looking forward to: "Captured by Me".', 'translation': 'iOS 27 係 Apple「相片」App 嘅一個重大更新，幻燈片展示、共享相簿等功能都有所提升，更加入咗一個好多用戶期待已久嘅相機底片類型功能：「由我拍攝」（Captured by Me）。'}

{'text': '"Captured by Me" in iOS 27\'s "Photos" app will only include photos and videos taken with the camera app', 'translation': 'iOS 27「相片」App 入面嘅「由我拍攝」只會收錄你用相機 App 影嘅相片同影片'}

{'text': 'Apple\'s "Photos" app has been expanding its functionality over the years. In addition to storing photos and videos taken with your iPhone, it also includes content shared with you by others, memories, screenshots, saved media, and more.', 'translation': 'Apple「相片」App 多年嚟功能不斷擴充，除咗儲存你 iPhone 影嘅相片同影片之外，亦包括其他人分享畀你嘅內容、回憶、螢幕截圖、已儲存嘅媒體等等。'}

{'text': 'The "Photos" app previously offered a "Camera Roll" feature similar to the current "Recents" album, which contained photos you took and images you saved.', 'translation': '「相片」App 以前提供過一個類似而家「最近項目」相簿嘅「相機底片」（Camera Roll）功能，入面包含你影嘅相片以及你儲存嘅圖片。'}

{'text': 'But for a long time, it has lacked a feature that truly only shows the photos and videos you took yourself, which is a feature that could more accurately be called "Camera Roll".', 'translation': '但好耐以嚟一直欠缺一個真正只顯示你親手影嘅相片同影片嘅功能，即係一個可以更準確噉稱為「相機底片」嘅功能。'}

{'text': 'iOS 27 finally brings this long-awaited feature, called "Captured by Me".', 'translation': 'iOS 27 終於帶來呢個期待已久嘅功能，叫做「由我拍攝」。'}

{'text': '"Captured by Me" in iOS 27 is a brand new photo collection in the "Photos" app. As the name suggests, it will only include media taken with the camera app.', 'translation': 'iOS 27 嘅「由我拍攝」係「相片」App 入面一個全新嘅相片集，顧名思義只會收錄你用相機 App 影嘅媒體。'}

{'text': "That means photos and videos taken with your iPhone will be gathered in one place, but you won't see screenshots, pictures sent by friends, or other types of content.", 'translation': '即係話你用 iPhone 影嘅相片同影片會集中喺度，但係唔會見到螢幕截圖、朋友傳畀你嘅圖片或者其他類型嘅內容。'}

{'text': 'In addition to this dedicated "Captured by Me" photo collection, you can also use the "Captured by Me" filter in the main "Photos" library.', 'translation': '除咗呢個專屬嘅「由我拍攝」相片集之外，你亦可以喺主要嘅「相片」圖庫入面用「由我拍攝」嘅篩選條件。'}

{'text': 'Regardless of how you use it, "Captured by Me" fills an important gap in the functionality of Apple\'s "Photos" app.', 'translation': '無論用邊種方式使用，「由我拍攝」都填補咗 Apple「相片」App 功能上嘅一個重要缺口。'}

{'text': 'Would you use this new "Photos" app feature in iOS 27? Feel free to let us know in the comments.', 'translation': '你會唔會用 iOS 27 嘅呢個新「相片」App 功能？歡迎喺留言區講畀我哋知。'}
